narr: Thunderstorms developed into west central Arkansas during the morning of the 7th. High moisture content of the air, and storms moving repeatedly across some of the same locations resulted in locally heavy rainfall and subsequently some flash flooding. The strongest storms produced damaging wind gusts.
ev: Portions of Old Uniontown Road were flooded.
Portions of multiple streets were flooded in Fort Smith.
Portions of Fayetteville Road were flooded.
Portions of several roads were flooded.
Portions of multiple roads west of Barling were flooded.
Portions of several roads were reported flooded between Fort Smith and Barling.
